title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the model's predictions would change if we used a different training dataset. It is often influenced by the complexity of the model.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: When you remove a feature from a model, you are essentially reducing the model's complexity. This can have various effects on the model's performance metrics.

title: Variance and Model Complexity
text: Reducing the number of features typically decreases the model's variance because there are fewer parameters to estimate, which reduces the model's sensitivity to the training data.
